BEHAVIOR_CROSS_DOMAIN.title: Cross-domain redirect observed
BEHAVIOR_CROSS_DOMAIN.description: An HTTP redirect points to another registrable domain. Cross-domain navigation is common and is not proof of phishing.

BEHAVIOR_REDIRECT_LOOP.title: Redirect loop detected
BEHAVIOR_REDIRECT_LOOP.description: An HTTP redirect points back to a previously visited destination. Following stopped; a loop is not itself proof of phishing.

BEHAVIOR_DUPLICATE_DESTINATION.title: Repeated redirect destination
BEHAVIOR_DUPLICATE_DESTINATION.description: A redirect destination repeats an earlier destination. The analyzer stopped rather than following it again.

BEHAVIOR_EXCESSIVE_REDIRECTS.title: Long redirect chain
BEHAVIOR_EXCESSIVE_REDIRECTS.description: Observed redirect headers reached the configured chain-length threshold. Long chains can be legitimate but require context.

BEHAVIOR_DOMAIN_HOPPING.title: Several domain transitions observed
BEHAVIOR_DOMAIN_HOPPING.description: The chain contains several registrable-domain transitions. The measured timing describes this scan, not evidence of malicious intent.

BEHAVIOR_SHORTENER.title: Known URL shortener
BEHAVIOR_SHORTENER.description: The submitted hostname appears in the existing shortener registry. Shorteners are not inherently malicious.

BEHAVIOR_HTTP_TO_HTTPS.title: HTTP to HTTPS redirect
BEHAVIOR_HTTP_TO_HTTPS.description: An HTTP redirect points from HTTP to HTTPS. This is common and is not by itself phishing evidence.

BEHAVIOR_HTTPS_TO_HTTP.title: HTTPS to HTTP redirect
BEHAVIOR_HTTPS_TO_HTTP.description: An HTTP redirect points from HTTPS to HTTP, which may reduce transport security. This is not automatically malicious.

BEHAVIOR_PORT_CHANGE.title: Redirect port change
BEHAVIOR_PORT_CHANGE.description: An HTTP redirect changes the effective destination port. Only ports allowed by the existing outbound policy can be contacted.

BEHAVIOR_META_REFRESH.title: Meta-refresh target detected
BEHAVIOR_META_REFRESH.description: Static HTML contains a meta-refresh destination. It was recorded without following or executing the navigation.

BEHAVIOR_JAVASCRIPT_REDIRECT.title: JavaScript navigation pattern
BEHAVIOR_JAVASCRIPT_REDIRECT.description: An inline script contains a literal location assignment or navigation call. This syntactic pattern may be inactive code; JavaScript was not executed.

BEHAVIOR_OBFUSCATED_SCRIPT.title: Encoded script context
BEHAVIOR_OBFUSCATED_SCRIPT.description: Existing Phase 4 script analysis detected encoding or obfuscation. No encoded destination was decoded or executed, and the pattern does not prove a redirect.

BEHAVIOR_FINAL_DOMAIN_CHANGE.title: Final domain differs from submitted domain
BEHAVIOR_FINAL_DOMAIN_CHANGE.description: The successfully fetched final document has a different registrable domain from the submitted URL. Such transitions can be legitimate.

BEHAVIOR_SUSPICIOUS_FINAL_DESTINATION.title: Redirect destination has corroborating risk evidence
BEHAVIOR_SUSPICIOUS_FINAL_DESTINATION.description: The observed final destination has an elevated calibrated URL-model estimate or a reliable malicious reputation observation. Phase 6 retains authority over the final verdict.

BEHAVIOR_CHALLENGE_PATTERN.title: Challenge-related markup
BEHAVIOR_CHALLENGE_PATTERN.description: Static markup contains a challenge or CAPTCHA naming pattern. This heuristic was not bypassed and does not establish phishing.

BEHAVIOR_NEW_WINDOW_PATTERN.title: New-window markup or script pattern
BEHAVIOR_NEW_WINDOW_PATTERN.description: Static analysis found a new-window reference or target-blank link. No new window was opened by the analyzer.

BEHAVIOR_STATIC_DESTINATION_BLOCKED.title: Restricted static navigation target
BEHAVIOR_STATIC_DESTINATION_BLOCKED.description: A static navigation target violates the existing URL policy. It was not contacted or executed.
